title: IPED Processing Command-Line Interface
description: Schema for IPED processing command-line arguments (java -jar iped.jar)

datasources.description: Input data sources to process. Can specify DD, E01, VHD, VHDX, VMDK, ISO, AFF, AD1, UFDR, folder, or .iped file

dname.description: Display names (optional) for each datasource added with -d. Must match datasources order

output.description: Output folder for case results. Defaults to parent directory of first datasource

keywords.description: Path to file with keywords to import into case. Keywords with no hits are filtered out

ocr.description: Run OCR only on specific categories or bookmarks (multiple allowed)

log.description: Path to redirect log messages to custom log file

asap.description: Path to .asap file (Brazilian Federal Police) with case info for HTML report

nocontent.description: Categories or bookmarks to exclude file contents from report (multiple allowed)

timezone.description: Original timezone of FAT devices (e.g., GMT-3, GMT-4). Uses system timezone if unspecified

blocksize.description: Sector block size in bytes. Must set to 4k for 4k sector devices

addowner.description: Index file owner information when processing local folders (slower on network)

append.description: Add data to be processed to an existing case

continue.description: Continue a stopped or aborted processing

restart.description: Discard last aborted processing and start from beginning

nogui.description: Do not open progress windows, use text mode processing

nologfile.description: Log messages to standard output instead of file

nopstattachs.description: Do not export PST/OST email attachments automatically to report

nolinkeditems.description: Do not export items linked to chats automatically to report

portable.description: Use relative references to forensic images, enabling case portability across machines

downloadInternetData.description: Download Internet data to enrich evidence processing (e.g., WhatsApp media still available on servers)

splash.description: Custom message to display in splash screen
